title: Every Era of Earth's History That Would Kill Doug (Marathon)
card: EVERY ERA TRIES TO KILL DOUG
intro: Doug has died in every mass extinction, every ice age and an atmosphere with too much oxygen. He has also dragged a hippo and a megalodon through time. Here are all five trips, back to back. Earth has never once been safe.
description: Five full episodes back to back: dying in every mass extinction, every time Earth froze, the age of giant oxygen-fed bugs, and whether a hippo and a megalodon could survive every era. Real science, cartoon deaths.
